title: 5 #### 1.4 The pattern of I.P.C. Crimes A comparative study of crimes committed under important crime heads during the period 1975-79 would show that the pattern of crime in 1979 did not vary much from the preceding years. For example the percentage of 'Murder' to the 'Total cognizable crime' during 1975-1979 varied between 1.4 and 1.5. However, the contribution of burglary and theft to total crime has been going down and the contribution of riots and miscellaneous offences going up. The details are presented in Table-3.
